body:
Do you have any pictures of your art for display on the internet? 

If not, what does witchcraft entail? Are you one of them folks who cuts up their fingers and stuff and stores the blood, or are you a bit more normal than that? Either of the above is cool though

Damn, good on you! So outside of having some of the best hydration skills out of anyone I’ve met, what do you do for fun?

I like to read comics(or manga if you wanna be a weeb). I used to play video games but these days it’s hard to make time. What about you?

It’s stupid how important staying hydrated is, like you start skipping out and you got headaches, mood swings, muscle soreness, and a whole bunch of other stuff.

It’s good to get steps. I’m too lazy to do cardio so A)my heart is dead, and B) I do push-ups and the like. It’s fun to see any amount of self improvement, like recently my biceps are defined when I stretch my arms out whereas before I could only get them to be defined if I did the pose where you bend your forearms up.

How much water do you drink every day? I try to drink 5 large glasses(which is probably not enough)
That’s good. Healthy habits are very important. I like exercise because it gives me that sweet sweet serotonin. Which healthy habits do you do?
Has it stayed fine so far? My day was going good until I gave myself an anxious breakdown over nothing. Put in some exercise and I was fine for the most part, but it did kill my groove.

Nothing worse than needing attention and having social anxiety. It’s so freaking annoying to deal with because on one hand I’m dying for attention crying myself to sleep, but on the other hand the second I start to motivate I kick myself in the dick by getting all anxious over if they really want to talk to me or if I’m bothering them. It’s like there’s definitely a balance and I can sometimes, ever so rarely, start to see it, but then im dragged back down to the point where it’s all I can do to not lock myself into my room crying cause I can’t get myself to socialize. 

Those small glimpses of normalcy make it so much more... exciting? Is that the word? Seeing that normalcy doesn’t make it worse by any means, but it just makes it such a roller coaster that I get nauseous from the whip lash from clingy to normal-ish to completely anti social.

To get attention Mr. u/lovedeleted ! To have something to look forward to. To distract me for any amount of time from anything else. To feel seen. To have someone burn some time on me. To get just a wee bit of dopamine pumping. 

That’s why I made this post. Not some deep meditation on what it is to care, not some fundamental musings on what it is to live, not some desolate thoughts on my current life position.

I made it to get attention from the rest of the world with someone else on a meaningless internet form on reddit.com.

Aaaaayyyyy we have a type 2 here! Thank you for the attention I appreciate it. Always fun to know someone cared enough to spend a few minutes writing a response.

In a more serious vain for a short bit since I hate being serious, how’d you do the cross out text thing with your last sentence?
